Calvin Hartley

Born 12 Mar 1842 in Fairview
Died 4 Jan 1918 in Fairview

Calvin Hartley edit

Son of Caleb Comstock Hartley and Harriet (Webb) Hartley edit

Brother of Warren Calvin Hartley

Husband of Ethel (Cole) Hartley — married 10 Jun 1866 in Fairview
Husband of Frances (Reed) Hartley — married 1874

Father of Edith Louise Hartley

Biography

* There is no evidence presented by the family historian that he and his wife are related on this side of the Atlantic.

According to the family history, "He was a carpenter, or 'housewright,' and lived at Fairview on the paternal homestead on South street." His reference here is to the History of Fairview (2.476). [1]
